entities.name: EMM Protocol
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management protocol used by UE and network for mobility management. Described using two different state machines for UE and MME sides.

entities.name: EMM Entity in UE
entities.description: EMM protocol entity located in the User Equipment. Its states are described in clause 5.1.3.2.

entities.name: EPS Update Status
entities.description: Status that determines UE behavior in EMM procedures. Described in clause 5.1.3.3.

entities.name: EMM Entity in MME
entities.description: EMM protocol entity located in the MME. Its states are described in clause 5.1.3.4.

relations.description: EMM protocol is described using state machines including the EMM entity in the UE
EMM protocol is described using state machines including the EMM entity in the MME
UE behavior depends on the EPS update status
